notes:
{冬|ふゆ} is the season of winter, typically from December to February in Japan.

SEASONS IN JAPANESE:
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧: spring
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧: summer
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧: autumn/fall
- {冬|ふゆ}: winter

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{冬休|ふゆやす}み→冬休み：19114_fuyuyasumi⟧: winter vacation
- ⟦{冬至|とうじ}→冬至：11756_touji⟧: winter solstice
- ⟦{真冬|まふゆ}→真冬：20587_mafuyu⟧: midwinter
- ⟦{冬服|ふゆふく}→冬服：23084_fuyufuku⟧: winter clothing
- ⟦{冬物|ふゆもの}→冬物：27498_fuyumono⟧: winter goods/items

CULTURAL ASSOCIATIONS:
{冬|ふゆ} is associated with ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ (New Year), ⟦スキー→スキー：03849_sukii⟧ (skiing), ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ (hot springs), and warm foods like ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (hot pot).

- {冬|ふゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in winter
